instruction: Open https://www.ndbc.noaa.gov/station_history.php?station=44013. From Historical data, select the full 2025 Standard meteorological data for Boston buoy 44013, then use the uncompressed text-view option. Do not select spectral wave data, supplemental measurements, current-year monthly data, or recent real-time observations. Initiate the observation-text request; a separately saved file is not required.
